create_training_pipeline: create a training pipeline that runs bert-base-cased on GLUE MRPC with accelerate
create_dataloaders_glue: create train and eval dataloaders from the glue mrpc dataset with bert tokenizer
run_training_with_accelerator: run distributed training with accelerate supporting cpu gpu tpu and mixed precision
run_gradient_accumulation: run gradient accumulation when batch size exceeds max gpu batch size
test_eval_with_gather_for_metrics: test model evaluation using accelerator gather_for_metrics for distributed aggregation
